key_evidence_spans: A 28-year-old man with a history of migraine disorder presented with several months of pain and swelling in the right mastoid area
Noncontrast CT of the head demonstrated a 3.0 × 3.0 × 1.1 cm hyperostotic lesion of the outer table of the right calvarium
MRI revealed a densely calcified mass measuring 3.6 × 1.5 × 3.0 cm involving the inferior squamosal portion of the right temporal bone
mucosal thickening was present in the right ethmoid air cells
a small amount of fluid was noted in the right mastoid air cells
laboratory studies, including a complete blood count, basic metabolic panel, thyroid-stimulating hormone, and free T4, were within normal limits
